parser.description: Autonomous sprint runner with multi-CLI validator ensemble. Any AI CLI implements, any AI CLI validates. Supports 15 built-in CLIs (claude, opencode, gemini, codex, vibe, aider, ollama, goose, interpreter, llama-cpp, gh-copilot, amazon-q, pi, qwen, agy) plus infinite custom providers via JSON. Three domains: engineering, business, research. Caveman mode (LOPE_CAVEMAN env var) compresses validator prompts 50-65%.
